footer.disclaimer: CivicSignal helps people understand public information. Always check the original source for official guidance.

landing.headline: Understand what’s happening around you.
landing.description: CivicSignal is being built to make public notices easier to find, understand, and connect to your neighbourhood—in English and Telugu.
landing.teluguTagline: మీ ప్రాంతం. మీ భాష. మీ సమాచారం.
landing.principleClarityText: Turn complicated public notices into plain, practical information with links back to their source.
landing.principleLocalText: Understand which places a notice names, with uncertainty shown clearly when the evidence is incomplete.
landing.principleEvidenceText: Keep the original source and supporting details close to every explanation.
landing.phaseDescription: This early version contains page shells only; no government notices are shown as live information.

notice.sourceAnalysisRequired: Run AI notice analysis first; the check uses its evidence-backed title, issuer, and notice date as candidates.

assistant.title: Voice assistant
assistant.description: Ask questions about your uploaded public notices in English or Telugu.
assistant.signInRequired: Sign in to ask questions about your private notices.
assistant.modeTitle: What would you like to ask about?
assistant.currentDescription: Questions will use the notice you opened.
assistant.allDescription: Questions will use your completed, readable notices.
assistant.currentNoticeRequired: Open a notice and choose “Ask about this notice” to use current-notice mode.
assistant.questionPlaceholder: Type your question about a public notice…
assistant.voicePrivacy: Speech input is transcribed locally in your browser; microphone audio is not sent to CivicSignal or a speech service. The first use downloads about 40 MB of model weights plus browser runtime files (the WebAssembly runtime is about 27 MB before compression). The browser caches files where supported. Review and edit the transcript before asking.
assistant.recognitionUnsupported: Local speech input is not supported in this browser or secure context. You can still type and submit questions.
assistant.localSpeechCompatibility: This browser cannot run the local speech model in its current configuration. Try an up-to-date browser or type your question instead.
assistant.microphoneDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Allow microphone access in your browser settings or type your question instead.
assistant.microphoneUnavailable: No usable microphone was found. Check your microphone or type your question instead.
assistant.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Try speaking again or type your question.
assistant.modelDownloadFailed: The speech model could not be downloaded. Check your connection and available storage, then try again or type your question.
assistant.modelMemoryLimit: This browser or device does not have enough memory to run local speech recognition. You can type your question instead.
assistant.localTranscriptionFailed: Local speech transcription could not complete. Try again or type your question.

voiceStatus.recording: Recording locally. Speak now, then stop recording.
voiceStatus.max-duration: The 30-second recording limit was reached. Transcribing locally…
voiceStatus.loading-model: Loading the local English and Telugu speech model. The first download may be large…
voiceStatus.downloading: Downloading and loading the speech model…
voiceStatus.transcribing: Transcribing locally. This may take a little while on slower devices…

assistant.loading: Preparing an answer from your notices…
assistant.aiGenerated: AI-generated answer. It is not official government guidance.
assistant.speechUnavailable: Spoken answers are not available in this browser. The written answer is still available.
assistant.speechVoiceUnavailable: A voice for the answer language is not available in this browser. The written answer is still available.
assistant.speechFailed: The answer could not be spoken. Please try again or read the written answer.
assistant.teluguTtsPrivacy: Telugu speech is generated locally in your browser. The first use downloads about 109 MiB of model weights from Hugging Face; answer text and generated audio stay in your browser. Model files are cached where supported.
assistant.teluguTtsUnavailable: Local Telugu speech is not supported in this browser. The written answer is still available.
assistant.teluguTtsDownloadFailed: The Telugu speech model could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again; the written answer is still available.
assistant.teluguTtsMemoryLimit: This browser or device may not have enough memory to generate Telugu speech. The written answer is still available.
assistant.teluguTtsFailed: Telugu speech could not be generated or played. Please try again or read the written answer.

teluguTtsStatus.loading-model: Loading the local Telugu speech model. The first download is about 109 MiB and may take time…
teluguTtsStatus.downloading: Downloading and caching Telugu speech model files…
